objective: Execute GCL-08 — Creature & Adversary Scaling/Role Kits. Build reusable role/transformation guidance that expresses source-supported adversaries differently without inventing mechanics, stats or canon.

acceptance_profile.breadth: 120 role kits across 20 role families and six transformation intents; exceeds GCL-18 adversary minimum 50.
acceptance_profile.source_integrity: Every kit requires exact source capabilities and becomes not_applicable when unsupported.
acceptance_profile.pressure: Every role names material GCL-07 pressure dimensions and counterplay.
acceptance_profile.authority: No unsupported mechanics/stat/canon invention, universal score, balance guarantee, live mutation or F012 authority.

next_action: Build, validate, merge and close GCL-08.
